events.did: traded the men’s bathroom for a corner booth and traded Victor’s cellmate for a curly brunette in a peasant dress
events.quote_anchor: TEN minutes later, they’d traded the men’s bathroom for a corner booth, and June had traded Victor’s cellmate for a curly brunette in a peasant dress.
“How is Syd?” asked June, as if they’d ended up on the subject of her obsession accidentally.

events.did: flicked her wrist and produced Victor’s vial
events.quote_anchor: She flicked her wrist, producing a vial—his vial. Victor swore inwardly.

events.did: ejected the half-empty vial from his inhaler and replaced it with the full one
events.quote_anchor: He ejected the half-empty vial from his inhaler and replaced it with the full one.

events.did: set the device on the table between them and spun it
events.quote_anchor: He set the device on the table between them and spun it, as if it were a gun at the center of another, equally lethal game.

events.did: thumbed through a set of playing cards, plucked out the face cards and tossed them down
events.quote_anchor: But as she thumbed through them, plucking out the face cards, and tossing them down, he noticed a system.

events.did: found the card she wanted, the jack of spades, and flicked it toward Victor
events.quote_anchor: “Aha.” She found the card she wanted—the jack of spades—and flicked it toward him.

events.did: scribbled her own number on the back of a joker and let it land face up beside the jack of spades
events.quote_anchor: Rising to her feet, she pulled a joker from the deck, and scribbled her own number on the back, letting it land face up beside the jack of spades.

relations.did: needed eyes inside EON and pressed June to help keep EON from going after Sydney
relations.quote_anchor: “If you want to help Sydney,” he pressed, “this is how. By making sure they don’t go after her.”

relations.did: took away the shadow-walking EO Dominic Rusher’s pain in exchange for his service and sent him undercover into EON, where he never came out
relations.quote_anchor: Victor had taken away the shadow-walking EO’s pain, in exchange for his service. Sent him undercover into EON, and he’d never made it out.

relations.did: turned on her boss Marcella, claimed she was protecting Sydney, and threatened to kill Mitch
relations.quote_anchor: She turned on her boss—claimed she was protecting Sydney—and threatened to kill Mitch if Victor didn’t help put Marcella down.

relations.did: called Sydney “our girl” and did not believe Victor had let her out of his sight
relations.quote_anchor: We both know you’re the controlling type. You don’t expect me to believe you’d actually let our girl out of your sight.
